::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

This section is adapted from @zhou2024eig,
used under the MIT License
(see the license text in @sec-subspaces).
These notes take eigenvalues to be real numbers (@def-eigenvalue),
so the source's complex eigenvalues are left out,
and eigenvalues are characterized through null spaces
rather than through the characteristic polynomial.
The source's two-vector argument that eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues are independent
is extended here to any number of eigenvectors.

:::
